## Meeting Purpose

[Sync on project updates and explore AI automation for ByteClub.](https://fathom.video/share/6wVx6Af5XMUi2uyLZUcB6vHugjMoHNxM?tab=summary&timestamp=121.0)

## Key Takeaways

  - [**AI Automation:** Explore using OpenClaw for ByteClub operations (marketing, lead gen) by creating a dedicated account to centralize services and leverage Google's €300 new-user credits.](https://fathom.video/share/6wVx6Af5XMUi2uyLZUcB6vHugjMoHNxM?tab=summary&timestamp=1805.0)
  - [**Automated Changelog:** Adrian built an automated changelog that uses AI to translate technical commit messages into user-friendly updates, improving user communication and providing an SEO-friendly public page.](https://fathom.video/share/6wVx6Af5XMUi2uyLZUcB6vHugjMoHNxM?tab=summary&timestamp=2005.0)
  - [**Product Launch Urgency:** Luís will launch his "Topic Canvas" tool to get real-world feedback, avoiding the "perfectionism trap" that delays product releases.](https://fathom.video/share/6wVx6Af5XMUi2uyLZUcB6vHugjMoHNxM?tab=summary&timestamp=873.0)
  - [**Sales Support:** Recruit sales support (e.g., Luís's cousin Nuno) for ByteClub, offering a 20% revenue share to accelerate growth.](https://fathom.video/share/6wVx6Af5XMUi2uyLZUcB6vHugjMoHNxM?tab=summary&timestamp=2340.0)

## Topics

### ByteClub Updates

  - [**Automated Changelog:** Adrian built a system to automate user-facing release notes.](https://fathom.video/share/6wVx6Af5XMUi2uyLZUcB6vHugjMoHNxM?tab=summary&timestamp=2005.0)
      - [**Workflow:** `release` → `main` merge → `semantic-release` creates a technical tag → AI rewrites tag into user-friendly copy and translates it.](https://fathom.video/share/6wVx6Af5XMUi2uyLZUcB6vHugjMoHNxM?tab=summary&timestamp=2042.0)
      - [**Outcome:** Users get in-app notifications and can view a public, SEO-friendly changelog page.](https://fathom.video/share/6wVx6Af5XMUi2uyLZUcB6vHugjMoHNxM?tab=summary&timestamp=2005.0)
  - [**Mobile HPR:** Luís is testing the mobile HPR feature.](https://fathom.video/share/6wVx6Af5XMUi2uyLZUcB6vHugjMoHNxM?tab=summary&timestamp=121.0)
  - [**Push Notifications:** Adrian created a story for push notifications, to be built in a separate PR.](https://fathom.video/share/6wVx6Af5XMUi2uyLZUcB6vHugjMoHNxM?tab=summary&timestamp=121.0)

### AI Automation Strategy

  - [**Goal:** Use OpenClaw to automate ByteClub tasks, freeing up time for high-value work.](https://fathom.video/share/6wVx6Af5XMUi2uyLZUcB6vHugjMoHNxM?tab=summary&timestamp=710.0)
  - [**Proposed Solution:** Create a dedicated ByteClub Google account to centralize services (Supabase, PostHog) and leverage Google's €300 new-user credits for initial API costs.](https://fathom.video/share/6wVx6Af5XMUi2uyLZUcB6vHugjMoHNxM?tab=summary&timestamp=1805.0)
  - [**Deployment:** The OpenClaw instance will run on a new VPS to avoid resource conflicts with Adrian's personal instance.](https://fathom.video/share/6wVx6Af5XMUi2uyLZUcB6vHugjMoHNxM?tab=summary&timestamp=1740.0)
      - [**Adrian's Setup:** Hostinger VPS (KVM2 plan) with a pre-defined OpenClaw script.](https://fathom.video/share/6wVx6Af5XMUi2uyLZUcB6vHugjMoHNxM?tab=summary&timestamp=1322.0)
      - [**Luís's Setup:** Contabo VPS.](https://fathom.video/share/6wVx6Af5XMUi2uyLZUcB6vHugjMoHNxM?tab=summary&timestamp=1235.0)
  - [**Potential Use Cases:**](https://fathom.video/share/6wVx6Af5XMUi2uyLZUcB6vHugjMoHNxM?tab=summary&timestamp=710.0)
      - [Marketing plan generation](https://fathom.video/share/6wVx6Af5XMUi2uyLZUcB6vHugjMoHNxM?tab=summary&timestamp=2196.0)
      - [Lead generation and outreach](https://fathom.video/share/6wVx6Af5XMUi2uyLZUcB6vHugjMoHNxM?tab=summary&timestamp=2196.0)
      - [Content creation (blog posts, social media)](https://fathom.video/share/6wVx6Af5XMUi2uyLZUcB6vHugjMoHNxM?tab=summary&timestamp=710.0)

### Luís's "Topic Canvas" Tool

  - [**Product:** A tool generating structured content outlines ("Topic Canvases").](https://fathom.video/share/6wVx6Af5XMUi2uyLZUcB6vHugjMoHNxM?tab=summary&timestamp=815.0)
  - [**Status:** Ready for launch but held back by a desire to improve "primitives" (e.g., the "annotator reveal" feature).](https://fathom.video/share/6wVx6Af5XMUi2uyLZUcB6vHugjMoHNxM?tab=summary&timestamp=873.0)
  - [**Decision:** Adrian advised launching immediately to get real-world feedback, avoiding the "perfectionism trap."](https://fathom.video/share/6wVx6Af5XMUi2uyLZUcB6vHugjMoHNxM?tab=summary&timestamp=873.0)
  - [**Business Model:**](https://fathom.video/share/6wVx6Af5XMUi2uyLZUcB6vHugjMoHNxM?tab=summary&timestamp=815.0)
      - [**Free Tier:** 3 topics/month](https://fathom.video/share/6wVx6Af5XMUi2uyLZUcB6vHugjMoHNxM?tab=summary&timestamp=830.0)
      - [**Pro Tier:** \~$9–10/month for 30 topics and private features](https://fathom.video/share/6wVx6Af5XMUi2uyLZUcB6vHugjMoHNxM?tab=summary&timestamp=830.0)
